title: Ganga Dussehra
significance: Celebrates the holy descent of the sacred River Ganga to Earth. Commemorated with clay oil lamps on ghats.
benefits: Taking a holy dip in the Shipra river at Ram Ghat, Ujjain.
puja: Shipra River Aarti & Holy Bath Rituals

title: Somvati Amavasya
significance: When Amavasya (new moon) falls on a Monday, it becomes exceptionally holy. Monday is dedicated to Lord Shiva.
benefits: Take a holy dip in the sacred Shipra River at Ram Ghat in Ujjain to seek blessings for ancestors and wash away obstacles.

title: Shani Pradosh Vrat
significance: Pradosh Vrat falls on the 13th day of the lunar fortnight. When it falls on a Saturday (Shani), it has special powers to remove planetary blocks.
benefits: Praying at Kal Bhairav Temple and Harsiddhi Shaktipeeth in Ujjain on Shani Pradosh offers protection from negative energies.

title: Shravan Maas (Holy Month Starts)
significance: The entire Hindu month of Shravan is dedicated to Lord Shiva. Sawan Mondays are celebrated with grand temple processions (Sawan Sawari) in Ujjain.
benefits: Performing assisted Rudrabhishek puja with Vedic Pandit Ji in Ujjain during Shravan brings peace, health, and prosperity to the family.

title: Dev Utthani Ekadashi
significance: The day Lord Vishnu awakens from his cosmic sleep, marking the beginning of the holy marriage season and pilgrimage circuits.
benefits: Ideal time to complete the Do Dham Yatra (Ujjain & Omkareshwar) with pleasant winter weather and clear river waters.
puja: Mamleshwar Abhishek Puja & Ghat Boat Ride

title: Kartik Poornima & Narmada Parikrama
significance: Kartik Poornima is highly sacred. It is the peak season to start the holy parikrama around the Mandhata island.
benefits: Doing the sacred parikrama path in Omkareshwar on this day fulfills deep devotional vows.
